Needs changes before merge.

The left-hand tap check stops posting before records or NC files are written. The tests cover all eight tapping posts. Tool hand survives file storage, catalog import, editor changes, undo and redo. This is a safety-tier review. I also read and tested the waterjet changes from parent PR #2001.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2026`, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `2f6de7c5b0eb7eb9053ce086a8e4705fc0776a78`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| App: machine_library, project_roundtrip, rigid_tapping, tap_hand, tapping_mode, tool_cutting_rows, tool_library, waterjet_machine | 138 passed |
| App: golden_cl, solid_law_goldens | 40 passed |
| Tools: library tests, tap_hand, waterjet | 88 passed |
| Post: library tests, waterjet_machine | 59 passed |
| UI: library tests, from crates/ui | 818 passed; 6 ignored by the suite |
| UI: tap_hand, waterjet_tool | 4 passed |
| Clippy: app, tools, motion, ui and post; all targets; warnings denied | Passed |

The selected test builds passed. The quick-gate plan was read with `--dry-run`; it was not a completed quick gate. The full batch and release snapshot tests were not run. No NC, CL or other golden fixture changed. I read both changed golden test files line by line; each change only supplies the default tool hand.

I repeated two of the stated mutations. Each test failed at runtime with the mutation and passed after the original file was restored:

- Replace `posting_family.rs` with upstream/main: `every_tapping_post_refuses_left_hand_for_rigid_floating_and_auto` failed because it received right-hand tapping records for a left-hand tap.
- Replace `tool_library.rs` with upstream/main: `hand_survives_project_and_library_and_old_readers_are_barred` failed because the library version was 1 instead of 2.

All temporary changes were restored.

Required before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:758` — The PR body has no before/after screenshots for the new tap-hand control. Add the required images and link them from the body. Store screenshots only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Include the waterjet UI changes while they remain part of this PR.
2. `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:98` — Saved projects now use version 62, which older readers refuse. Commit `c51f5541` has neither `!` nor a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Add the required breaking-change marker to the commit metadata and state the file compatibility change. Keep the version barrier; it prevents loss of tap hand. The repository's release rules require this marker for an incompatible project-file change.

The PR is mergeable, but these two items require `needs-rework`. It remains a draft. Parent PR #2001 must merge first, as stated in the body.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Both review findings are addressed.

1. Added immutable before/after tap-hand and waterjet screenshot links to the PR body. Images live only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. Pin: `before_after_ui_screenshot_links` failed when the image links were removed and passed after restoration.
2. Added an additive `fix(project)!:` commit with a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Saved projects use format 62. Older readers refuse them to prevent loss of tap hand. The version barrier remains. Pin: `breaking_marker_and_file_compatibility` failed when the marker was removed and passed after restoration.

New head: `83dfc4d7e40cfffb6943c27a8b546be63bc64154`.

Quick gate: green (5 steps, 0 failures).
Touched-crate clippy: green (app, tools, motion, ui and post; all targets; `-D warnings`).

The source tree is unchanged from the reviewed head. Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 83dfc4d7e40cfffb6943c27a8b546be63bc64154 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This safety-tier review clears both findings from the earlier review:

- The PR body now has before/after tap editor images. I opened both images and checked the new control. The body also links the waterjet images. The image links use fixed commit IDs on the fork. No review images were added to this PR branch.
- Commit `83dfc4d7` has a `fix(project)!:` subject and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. It states that older readers refuse project format 62. The version barrier remains. The source tree is unchanged from the earlier reviewed head.

Parent PR #2001 has merged. The remaining change stores tap hand and refuses unsupported left-hand taps before posting records or NC files. The tests cover the eight tapping posts, file storage, catalog input, editor changes, undo and redo. I found no new blocking item.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2026`, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| App: golden_cl | 33 passed |
| App: project_roundtrip | 73 passed |
| App: rigid_tapping | 5 passed |
| App: solid_law_goldens | 7 passed |
| App: tap_hand | 7 passed |
| App: tapping_mode | 4 passed |
| App: tool_library | 14 passed |
| App: recorded_post_streams | 5 passed |
| Tools: library tests and tap_hand | 82 passed |
| Motion: drilling library tests and center_cut_owed | 49 passed |
| UI: library tests, from crates/ui | 826 passed; 6 ignored by the suite |
| UI: tap_hand | 3 passed |
| Clippy: app, tools, motion and ui; all targets; warnings denied | Passed |

Total: 1,208 tests passed. The selected test builds passed. The quick-gate dry-run included incoming main files because the trial merge was not committed. I ran the selected suites directly; this is not a completed quick or full gate. Release snapshot tests were not run.

I repeated two of the PR's mutations myself:

1. Replace `posting_family.rs` with upstream/main. `every_tapping_post_refuses_left_hand_for_rigid_floating_and_auto` failed at runtime with `left-hand tap cannot dump RH records`. The test passed after restoration.
2. Replace `tool_library.rs` with upstream/main. `hand_survives_project_and_library_and_old_readers_are_barred` failed at runtime with `old library readers must refuse left-hand taps`: the actual version was 1; the required version was 2. The test passed after restoration.

All temporary changes were restored. No NC, CL or other golden fixture changed. I read each changed golden-test line: the changes only supply the default right-hand field.

Required before merge: none.

Non-blocking note: the small additions to `pages.rs`, `state.rs` and the project DTO file increase files that already exceed the repository's 400-line target.

The current head is MERGEABLE. This review replaces the earlier needs-rework result with merge-ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
